description: Get US non-farm payroll employment by industry (manufacturing, construction, retail, financial, government, etc.). Returns employment figures in thousands by period.

_apiKey.description: Optional BLS registration key (free, raises the daily cap from ~25 to 500). The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

industry.description: Industry to retrieve. One of: "total_nonfarm", "manufacturing", "construction", "retail", "financial", "government". Defaults to "total_nonfarm".

name: get_employment_by_industry
